ctx.x: Right. Eddie Heywood came there... When I came back to Los Angeles to live, Eddie was in there at the time, with that great group he had with Lem Davis and John Simmons and Emmett Berry, and Keg Johnson, the great trombone player -- his brother was playing the drums, and I can't really call his name. But anyway, they were really, really hot. He had the big hit records out, and... 'Begin The Beguine' was the big hit they had going at the time, yeah.
And down the street farther, they had a couple of clubs. The Cobra Room, which I will mention a little later...
